mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level signals insufficient monetary easing to counteract economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate reduced corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it indicates the Federal Reserve is not easing sufficiently to prevent economic deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high unemployment (UNRATE >= 5.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 115) signals a severe economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both UNRATE >= 5.0% and INDPRO < 115.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (UNRATE > 5.0% and HOUST < 1200), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 115) indicates worsening economic conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 115 and recessionary regime conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate directly reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day forward returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.8%, it signals accelerating labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.8%.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS < 385000) indicates a broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS < 385000.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing bust regime (HOUST < 1200), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS < 385000) signals reduced consumer spending power, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 385000 and HOUST < 1200.
